referee_caveats_inferred: Many CPROPS settings are inherited from an unnamed M51 reference whose citation is missing in the text.
Table 2 gives M_u(Bar-end) = 14.8 +/- 0.93 x1e6 Msun while the text gives (1.3 +/- 3.4) x1e7 Msun.
Region masks (Bar, Arm, Bar-end) are drawn by hand, so environment assignment is not reproducible from the text alone.
Roughly 70 % of GMCs are detected at S/N 4-7 and 67 of 233 have only single-channel peaks, so catalog completeness and sigma_v are sensitive to CPROPS settings.
K-S tests with small samples per environment have limited power to detect real differences.
